Week 34/2026 (17 Aug - 24 Aug)
Comment: Australian Iron Ore Exports
MARKET REPORT -WEEK 34/2026
2COMMENT
AUSTRALIAN IRON ORE EXPORTS
2025 was another positive year for
global seaborne iron ore trade. In Jan-Dec 2025, global loadings of
iron ore increased by +3.5% y-o-y to
1,732.0 mln tonnes, based on AXS
Marine vessel tracking data. 2026 has continued on a positive
note, with export volumes up by
+1.8% y-o-y in Jan-Jul 2026 to 978.3
mln tonnes.
